name: Krea 2 [large]
description: Krea's own model, aimed at photographic realism. Text to image only on fal, so it works in "Generate new", not in Generate. Model id from fal's model index on 2026-09-11; the adapter is written from the provider's schema and has not run against the live API yet.

fal.note: Text to image only, and the size comes from the aspect ratio, not from pixels: the dialog's aspect is sent, its long side is ignored.
